text: Does a localized Gaussian wave packet v(x,0)=4*exp(-(x+5)^2/2.25), u(x,0)=0 decompose into a soliton train (>=2 peaks each with amplitude >=0.8) in the coupled Burgers-swept-KdV system by T=6.0, and can we compute this accurately with mass(v) drift < 8%?

method: Fourier pseudospectral + explicit RK4, NO dealiasing
bank_use_rationale: BKdV-S1 (depth=3) and kb-kdv-noDealiasing-aliasing-artifacts both warn that no-dealiasing on Fourier grid blows up before t=0.5 via aliasing overflow; running this simplest baseline anyway per progressive-complexity discipline to observe the exact failure mode before escalating.

rationale: Aliasing overflow in quadratic products (v*v_x, u*v_x) cascades into FFT NaN at t=0.426, exactly matching BKdV-S1 prediction of blow-up before t=0.5. Confirms dealiasing is essential.

Failure mode is aliasing overflow — single-component fix is to add 2/3-rule dealiasing on all nonlinear products, keeping same RK4 time integrator and dt=2e-4 (BKdV-S1 deep synthesis shows this exact change stabilises the run at amp [1,3]).

method: Fourier pseudospectral + explicit RK4 + 2/3-rule dealiasing on all nonlinear products
bank_use_rationale: BKdV-S1 deep synthesis (depth=3) explicitly validated Fourier+2/3-rule+RK4 at dt=2e-4 up to amp=3.0 on BKdV; adding 2/3 dealiasing is the single-component change indicated by F1 failure mode (aliasing overflow). No negative entries warn against dealiasing — the warnings in kb-kdv-noDealiasing-aliasing-artifacts and BKdV-S1 confirm dealiasing is the cure.

diagnostics.first_run_blowup: t=0.006, step=29 (bug: state not dealiased, modes 86-127 unstable: |dt*k_Nyquist^3|=3.85>3.46)
diagnostics.bugfix: pre-dealias state in RHS so all k^3 terms bounded by k_eff=17.87 (dt*k_eff^3=1.13<3.46)

rationale: After fixing state-dealiasing bug: run completes to T=6, 15 positive peaks in v all with amplitude >=0.8 (min=0.899), well separated (min gap 0.938), mass drift 0.000%. Phenomenon target (>=2 peaks with amp>=0.8, drift<8%) is unambiguously met. The soliton train decomposes from the Gaussian IC as expected from KdV IST physics; periodic-domain recirculation of faster solitons creates multiple peaks by T=6.
E2 produces a physically valid soliton train: 15 peaks with amplitude in [0.899, 4.10], zero mass drift, all-finite. Phenomenon target exceeded. No further iterations needed.
